objective: Find the 1's complement (bitwise NOT) of an 8-bit number.
theory: The CMA (Complement Accumulator) instruction inverts all 8 bits of the Accumulator (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0).
algorithm: 1. Load number from 2050H into Accumulator A.
assembly_code:
LDA 2050H   ; Load number from 2050H
CMA         ; Complement Accumulator (1's complement)
STA 2051H   ; Store 1's complement at 2051H
HLT
